summary: Preserve dynamic cpSync filter callback invocation and its effect on which paths are copied.

semantics.callback: filter receives source and destination paths and may run for multiple tree entries
semantics.side_effects: filter side effects and thrown exceptions are observable

caveats: A C# predicate is safe only after full JS callable/closure lowering.
Filter invocation order follows traversal and must not be invented as sorted/deterministic if Node does not promise it.
Thrown JS values/callback state may require the JS compatibility runtime.

tests.name: filter excludes file
tests.expected_behavior: entries rejected by the JS filter are not copied; callback side effects are preserved

tests.name: filter throw aborts
tests.expected_behavior: the thrown JS exception escapes according to Node/JS semantics and copying stops accordingly
